lead: Friday opens with a quiet geopolitical beat and a loud engineering one: [at a White House summit, Xi Jinping said the US and China have 'the capability and responsibility to develop and manage AI for good'](../summaries/468aea7c71ac.md), casting both as AI's leading nations, while [Google unveiled Project Suncatcher](../summaries/a1a9cda1ffd3.md), a moonshot launching a prototype satellite to test whether its AI hardware can survive orbit. The code-breaking saga continued too: [researchers are still picking through the GPT-6 Astra logs](../summaries/a2d471e92c66.md) and adding newly surfaced Bundesarchiv radio messages to the 1941 list. And for builders, [Show HN: Critic](../summaries/0be0b63b98a2.md) proposes reviewing code with the same agent that wrote it.
